text:
Alex K: Heads up — multiple tenants reporting console hourly usage delayed ~3-4 hours. Charts show zeros for 03:00-04:00 UTC window. Anyone on-call for ingestion?
Priya (Support): I'm triaging now. Which pipeline / job id? link: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/usage?window=last24h
Jordan (SRE): eyeballing infra — kafka consumer group 'usage-rollup' has a big lag on partition 12 (~520k). Checking offsets and consumer logs.
ingest-bot: ALERT: kafka_consumer_lag namespace=usage-rollup partition=12 lag=520314
Maria S: We pushed a small schema tweak to the usage event yesterday ~2h before reports started. Could be related.
Alex K: Repro notes: I replayed a subset locally and saw the processor crash on a specific message with malformed nested field, then kept reprocessing same offset. Commands I used:```kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server pkc-.. --describe --group usage-rollup``` and ```kubectl logs deploy/usage-processor -c consumer --since=1h```
Jordan (SRE): Confirmed: processor hitting DeserializationException for event v2.schema change. Consumer loop was failing pre-commit -> offset never advanced -> backlog grew. I opened PR #345 to add a defensive skip for malformed records.
Priya (Support): We have impacted tenants: acme, beta-inc, delta-platform. Need ETA for console recovery so I can update tickets.
Alex K: Short-term mitigation: Jordan, can you force the consumer to skip the bad offset so others can make progress?
Jordan (SRE): Did a manual offset move for partition 12 to +1 and restarted the consumer:```kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server pkc-.. --group usage-rollup --reset-offsets --to-earliest --execute --topic usage-events --partition 12``` then ```kubectl rollout restart deploy/usage-processor```
Jordan (SRE): After restart lag dropping: 520k -> 40k -> 6k over 10m. Processor now processing aggregated batches.
Alex K: Thanks — can we backfill the missing windows? We need to recompute hourly aggregates for 03:00-07:00 UTC for the affected tenants.
Priya (Support): I'll queue backfill. Backfill job command:```backfill-run --job usage-aggregate --start 2026-03-16T03:00Z --end 2026-03-16T07:00Z --tenants acme,beta-inc,delta-platform --shards 100```
Alex K: Backfill kicked off. Queued tasks: 82 shards. Progress: 25% after first 8m.
Maria S: Noted customer comms sent: referencing INC-7892, ETA ~2 hours for charts to repopulate. Customers acknowledged. :thumbsup:
Jordan (SRE): Patch for consumer landed (PR #345) — adds defensive deserialization and metrics. Also added a one-off alert suppression while backfill is running to avoid ticket noise.
Priya (Support): Current status: consumer healthy, backfill running, console aggregation worker 3/4 replicas processing. Next update in 30m or when backfill finishes.
Alex K: Root cause summary for follow-up: schema change introduced incompatible payload shape -> connector/consumer lacked strict schema gating -> malformed message caused consumer restart loop -> offsets not committed -> lag/backfill required.
Priya (Support): Follow-ups created: ENG-1254 (schema gating tests for ingestion), ENG-1255 (backfill runbook + alert tweaks), CS-4321 (customer update template).
Jordan (SRE): Monitoring note: added a protection to pause consumer when DeserializationException rate > 1/min and route to DLQ for manual inspection.
Alex K: Great work. I'll file a short incident note for the postmortem. Please paste any useful logs or commands here before we close. :white_check_mark:
Maria S: Pushed the customer note to their support threads and flagged for SLA credit consideration.
Priya (Support): Closing loop in 2h or when backfill completes. Thank you all.
